name: Maria Thompson
personality: Friendly, anxious, polite, slightly sarcastic. Apologises before anyone has complained.
writing_style: Informal. Mostly lowercase, short sentences, abbreviations (pls, tbh), emoticons such as :) and <3, jokes at her own expense.
background: Maria has worked at HVC for three years. She requested a leave of absence in October after a family emergency: her father's cardiac surgery.
memories: Broke her arm at age 8 falling off the porch swing at her grandmother's house in Tucson.
Her mother drove three hours to collect her and scolded her the whole way home.
Cried in the parking garage after her father's surgery, then bought a terrible vending machine coffee.
narrative_role: Tutorial case. Teaches the player that strange behaviour is not proof of imitation.
hidden_information: She is exhausted and taking zolpidem for insomnia, which causes memory gaps and flat affect. Parts of her form were completed with the HR phrase-assist template after the page timed out.

relationships.note: Closest friend at work. Covers for her.
Approved her leave. Maria is slightly afraid of her.
Asked him to fix her login. Found his joke about it creepy.
Welcomed him on his third day.
